svg.title: Understand the user. Transform the same starting scene.
svg.desc: Two users provide profiles and the same desk-setup instruction. A personal robot agent infers different mouse and paper-notebook placement preferences. One shared policy and robot operate from identical initial desk states. Each user's before and after views retain the same fixed keyboard and monitor. Initial object coordinates follow Task 1; final views illustrate reference layouts. Held-out user preferences are used only for evaluation. The mug is omitted because this concept illustrates the mouse and paper-notebook layout only, not a full-task result.

g.text: Task 1 desk-layout illustration · Same initial state · Mug omitted.
